Requirement: The system shall incorporate a linear rail mechanism with a sliding carriage.
The resting position of the sliding carriage shall be located at a minimum horizontal distance of 14cm from the panel edge.
The sliding carriage shall mount and mechanically couple the thermal camera and the water nozzle.
The system shall provide independent tilt mechanisms for the cleaning nozzle.
The base structure shall provide mounting points for the photovoltaic module, linear rail assembly, water pump, and electronic enclosures.
The water hose shall have a maximum length of 150 cm and minimum length of 50 cm
The primary base structure shall allow for manual adjustment of its inclination angle to simulate different solar panel mounting setups.
The system shall NOT include mechanisms for physical (brush or wiper) contact cleaning; cleaning is limited to water-jet spraying only.
The reservoir and pump assembly shall NOT include automatic refilling from an external water source
The tilt mechanisms for both the cleaning nozzle and the thermal camera shall be actuated exclusively by servo motors.
The system shall NOT incorporate any cooling mechanisms intended to lower the temperature of a detected hotspot.
The base structure shall measure at most 100 cm in length, 40 cm in width, and 40 cm in height.
The primary base structure shall be constructed from acrylic or MDF/Wood.
The sliding carriage shall be driven by a stepper motor coupled to a timing belt to enable horizontal translation across the panel.
The linear rail mechanism shall utilize a V-slot profile.
The linear rail shall have a minimum length of 70 cm.
The motor driving the sliding carriage shall be a NEMA 17 stepper motor.
The system shall route the water hose to accommodate the full travel of the carriage along the rail.
The water hose connected to the nozzle shall be made of flexible silicone.
The mechanical mount coupling the thermal camera and water nozzle shall be custom 3D-printed.
The hose routing design shall prevent tangling or kinking during the full horizontal travel of the carriage.
The nozzle tilt mechanism shall actuate the nozzle vertically to sweep the water jet across the full vertical length of a targeted continuous strip on the solar panel.

The camera tilt mechanism shall actuate the thermal camera vertically to ensure its field of view (FOV) fully covers the targeted continuous strip for accurate thermal measurement and hotspot detection.
The water flow path shall utilize a flexible hose to connect the base-mounted reservoir to the movable carriage
The pump/valve assembly shall limit the jet pressure at the nozzle to a range of 2 bar.
The pump/valve assembly shall limit the water flow rate at the nozzle to 30 mL/s.
The water reservoir opening must be physically accessible for refilling without requiring the removal or disassembly of any other system component.
The linear rail mechanism shall provide a resting zone for the sliding carriage outside the active area of the solar panel.
The water reservoir shall be mechanically fixed to the base of the structure
The water reservoir shall have a volumetric capacity of 2 liters.
The water reservoir shall be manufactured from acrylic or plastic material.
The water reservoir shall feature a removable lid to allow for manual water refills.
The system shall transport water from a water reservoir to a cleaning nozzle mounted on the carriage
The system shall provide independent tilt mechanisms for the thermal camera.
The thermal camera shall be mounted perpendicular to the photovoltaic panel surface, at a distance of 12–15 cm from the panel.
The linear rail mechanism shall be mounted along the top section of the primary base structure.
